instruction.text: Schiebe die Passivbildungen und Beispielsätze zur richtigen Zeitform.

atoms.sound: am, is, are. plus past participle

atoms.b: The ball is caught by the goalkeeper.
The eggshells were thrown into the bin.

hint.text: Das Passiv wird mit dem past participle des Verbs gebildet.
hint.sound: Das Passiv wird mit dem <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>past participle</voice> des Verbs gebildet

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz im Passiv, indem du die richtige Verbform einsetzt.

atoms.b: This new house ((++was_built build is_building)) with expensive and valuable resources.
The class ((++is_shown showed was_showing)) a film about the tremendous effects of global warming.
All their toys ((++are_torn are_tearing tore)) apart by them.
All the guests ((++were_sent sent are_sending)) a personal invitation online.
Dilan ((++was_told is_telling tell)) a story he would never forget.

instruction.text: Schreibe die Passivform in der gegebenen Zeitform in die Lücke.

atoms.b: Pepe started a fight because he ((was_pushed)) by Manuel.
My favourite song ((is_listened)) to by over 100,000 people a month.
Many batteries ((are_recycled)) so that the contained materials can be reused.
Yesterday, my siblings ((were_driven)) to football practice because it was raining.
